what_happened: No Philippine source publishes technology-level non-fuel variable operating cost. Checked: PSA OpenSTAT folder 3S/C14 holds only supply, generation, capacity and consumption tables (14.1a to 14.17), no cost tables; the Annual Survey of Philippine Business and Industry reports total expense by industry, not by generating technology; the DOE Power Development Plan tables give capacity and generation, not O&M.
consequence: All 18 power proposals fall to tier 2, the US EIA, under ASM_EIA_PROXY.
how_to_close: Ask the Energy Regulatory Commission for the fuel and non-fuel cost components in generation rate filings, or NPC and PSALM audited statements for plant-level O&M.

what_happened: No published non-fuel operating cost for Philippine refining, gas processing, coal preparation or biofuel production. DOE publishes retail price build-ups, not refinery operating cost, and a search for the DOE bioethanol and biodiesel reference prices returned only blending-mandate circulars, not the price tables.
consequence: Four processing technologies keep the placeholder. PHL_PRO_PROC_BIOF is the worst case: it has no input commodity at all, so with a placeholder VariableCost the model makes biofuel out of nothing at almost zero cost.
how_to_close: DOE Oil Industry Management Bureau for refinery cost build-ups; the Sugar Regulatory Administration for the bioethanol reference price; USDA FAS Manila Biofuels Annual as a secondary source.

what_happened: These nine technologies cannot be priced because their unit basis is inconsistent. Their CapitalCost is a whole-vehicle price - 89,000 MUSD per 10^3 aircraft is 89 million USD each - but their activity is not vehicle-kilometres. Shipping carries 393.99 x 10^9 activity units in 2020 at 0.084 PJ each, which is 0.084 MJ per unit, a tonne-kilometre figure, not a ship-kilometre figure. Aviation is 12.4 MJ per unit, an order of magnitude below the roughly 130 MJ an aircraft burns per kilometre. Rail is 88 MJ per unit, which is a train-kilometre. ResidualCapacity is correspondingly unusable: 3.94 million ships and 2 trains.
consequence: No variable cost can be proposed for nine technologies until the unit basis is fixed. Their capital costs are wrong by three to four orders of magnitude for the same reason.
how_to_close: Restate the non-road transport block on one explicit basis, then price it. Philippine activity denominators exist: PSA Philippine Statistical Yearbook table 13.1 (railway passengers and revenues), 13.2 (light rail transit), 13.7 (shipping cargo and passengers) and 13.10a (aircraft, cargo and passenger movement by airport).

what_happened: The 2017 Transportation Science Society of the Philippines jeepney fare paper defines maintenance as 0.1 times fixed cost, about 18.75 PHP per day over 108 km per day, or 0.17 PHP/km. That is an assumption inside the paper's own model, not an observation, so it was rejected.
consequence: None. The paper's distance data - 12 km per trip, 9 trips per day, 45 passengers per trip - remains usable for other purposes.
